scenario:generated_at="not-a-ts", freshness=60 -> None; grounded_event_date then uses model date which may pass the 72 h+7 d window when the real publish time would not.

scenario:source_published=now+10 d (clock skew or bad metadata) passes the gate even though the story is not yet published.
fix:add `if source_published and source_published > now: stale=True`.
</high>
